title: Samira Rahimova
lead: Couple relationships, the parent-child bond and work with difficult adolescents — therapy and training.

blocks.sub: Clinical psychologist · family therapy specialist and trainer

items.d: To the present day — clinical psychologist. Diploma in clinical psychology from the B. D. Karvasarsky Institute (St. Petersburg). Private practice: couple relationships, the parent-child bond, anxiety disorders
Certificate in family therapy from the International Psychotherapy Accreditation Society (IPAS) — work with couples and difficult adolescents
Clinical psychotherapy practicum at the RAGIMOFF School of Psychology

Family therapy modules at the St. Petersburg Institute of Additional Professional Education for Psychologists and Psychotherapists; lectures on family therapy for students of the RAGIMOFF School of Psychology
Personal development trainer and coach. Training in public relations, communication and public speaking
The role of Jeyran in the feature film “Kişiləri qoruyun” — directed by Sharif Gurbanaliyev
Founder and editor-in-chief of the magazine “ATV maqazin” — until December 2012
Presenter of the programme “Şarm” on ATV — ten years on air
Academy of Fine Arts — degree in fine art
Azerbaijan State Institute of Arts, faculty of theatre and cinema — actress of theatre and cinema

p: Registration must be completed in advance: places are allocated among those enrolled in the training group. Without it, it is not possible to join the group. Registration is open — applications are being accepted for the next group.

blocks.sub: The work starts with a joint intake, continues individually and joins again.
p: Therapy is led by two specialists: the man’s side by psychiatrist Kenan Rahimov, the woman’s side by clinical psychologist Samira Rahimova. The work begins with a joint intake: both sides are heard in the same room and the situation is assessed together. Then comes the individual stage — each person explores their own part in a safe setting rather than in front of the partner. In the closing joint session the results are brought together and agreements are made. A session lasts one hour, in person or online. The full description of the process and the prices are on a separate page.

blocks.sub: Evidence-based publications and practical advice on the topic.
3 months of training + 6 months of group supervision. 300 AZN a month × 3 or 800 AZN at once.
